title: Off-World Interceptor Extreme
overview:
Extreme Car Crushing Combat!

- Switch on the fly between cockpit and chase views.
- Send a buddy to oblivion in two player head-to-head mode.
- Hate cheesy video? So do we. Bust a gut watching two trash talkers smack the gratuitous video.
- Story mode offers 26 levels of brutality with password support.
- Blast across rugged 3D texture-mapped terrain as you blow away huge bosses.
